overview:
This 10 day Tanzania safari and Zanzibar beach trip spends 7 nights on safari, from Serval Wildlife to Tarangire, Lake Manyara, 3 nights at Serengeti Serena and a night at Melia Ngorongoro Crater, then flies you to 2 beach nights at Melia Zanzibar. The page gives no fixed season. It costs from USD 6,130 per adult and USD 4,590 per child, so it suits families and couples.

Why choose a 10 day Tanzania safari and Zanzibar beach trip?

The 10 day Tanzania safari and Zanzibar beach trip packs more activities into its safari days than a standard northern circuit. Beyond game drives, it includes a close animal encounter at Serval Wildlife, cycling to a Maasai village near Mto wa Mbu, a canoe ride, a night game drive in Lake Manyara National Park and a sundowner on the Serengeti plains.

  • Serengeti time: 3 nights at Serengeti Serena Safari Lodge with two full days on the plains.
  • Ngorongoro Crater: an afternoon game drive on the crater floor, home to the rare black rhino.
  • Easy finish: the Arusha to Zanzibar return flight is included.

What to expect on the 10 day Tanzania safari and Zanzibar beach trip

Day 1 starts at Kilimanjaro International Airport with a drive of about 2 hours to Serval Wildlife for an animal interaction and a night at Serval Wildlife Villas. Day 2 is about 3 hours to Tarangire National Park for a full-day game drive and a picnic by the Tarangire River, with the night at Manyara Secret Lodge.

Day 3 is about 2 hours to Mto wa Mbu for a 1 to 2 hour bike ride through banana farms to a Maasai village, an evening canoe ride and a night game drive in Lake Manyara National Park. The night is at Lake Manyara Kilimamoja Lodge.

Day 4 is about 5 hours from Karatu to the Serengeti through the Ngorongoro Conservation Area, passing Olduvai Gorge, with an afternoon game drive. Days 5 and 6 are full Serengeti days following the herds. All three nights are at Serengeti Serena Safari Lodge.

Day 7 is about 4 hours to the Ngorongoro Crater for a picnic by a hippo pool and an afternoon crater game drive, then a night at Melia Ngorongoro Crater. On day 8 you fly to Zanzibar for 2 nights at Melia Zanzibar. Day 9 is free on the beach, and on day 10 you fly to Arusha and drive about 1 hour to Kilimanjaro Airport.

When is the best month to see the migration on this trip?

The best month to see the migration on this trip depends on where the herds are: December to March in the southern Serengeti for the calving season, and July to October in the north for the river crossings. Our great migration month by month guide explains each month, and our Lake Manyara National Park guide covers the trip's third park.

What is included in the 10 day Tanzania safari and Zanzibar beach trip?

  • Included: a meet and greet and safari briefing, transport in a 4WD Land Cruiser, the return flight from Arusha to Zanzibar, 9 nights of accommodation as per the itinerary, full board meals, all park entry and conservation fees, an English or bilingual driver-guide, unlimited game drives and drinking water, the Lake Manyara night game drive, cycling, Maasai village visit and canoe ride, and a sundowner in the Serengeti.
  • Not included: travel insurance, visas, international flights, the Serengeti hot air balloon safari (USD 600 per adult), tips (about USD 10 per person per day), personal items and drinks.

The 10 day Tanzania safari and Zanzibar beach trip has a sister trip, the 11 Days Tanzania Safari and Zanzibar Beach Holiday, with 4 nights in Stone Town. Read our Zanzibar beach extension guide to plan your beach days.

From USD 6,130 per adult (USD 4,590 per child). The final price depends on your travel dates, group size and the lodges available, and we confirm every lodge in your written quote.

faq.q: When is the best time for the 10 day Tanzania safari and Zanzibar beach trip?
faq.a: The 10 day Tanzania safari and Zanzibar beach trip runs all year, and the page gives no fixed season. June to October is dry, with easy game viewing, river crossings in the northern Serengeti and sunny beach days. December to March brings calving in the southern Serengeti. April and May are the long rains. Tell us your dates and we will check where the herds should be.

faq.q: What is included in the 10 day Tanzania safari and Zanzibar beach trip?
faq.a: The 10 day Tanzania safari and Zanzibar beach trip includes 9 nights of full board accommodation, a 4WD Land Cruiser and driver-guide, all park and conservation fees, unlimited game drives, the Arusha to Zanzibar return flight, cycling, a Maasai village visit, a canoe ride, a night game drive and a sundowner. Insurance, visas, international flights, the balloon safari, tips and drinks are extra.

faq.q: Where do you stay on the 10 day Tanzania safari and Zanzibar beach trip?
faq.a: On the 10 day Tanzania safari and Zanzibar beach trip you stay at Serval Wildlife Villas, Manyara Secret Lodge, Lake Manyara Kilimamoja Lodge, 3 nights at Serengeti Serena Safari Lodge, 1 night at Melia Ngorongoro Crater and 2 nights at Melia Zanzibar. We confirm each property and room type in your written quote.

faq.q: Is the 10 day Tanzania safari and Zanzibar beach trip good for children?
faq.a: Yes, the 10 day Tanzania safari and Zanzibar beach trip works well for children, with a child price of USD 4,590 and activities beyond game drives, such as the Serval Wildlife encounter, a canoe ride and a Maasai village visit. The bike ride takes 1 to 2 hours on easy tracks. The longest drive is about 5 hours, from Karatu to the Serengeti.
